name: Direct-pair knuckle: K's follower arm (lug on link 1a, O5 roller) on a link-2 lobe plate - no rocker, rod or rod ends; roller and groove embodiments
lens: round7:direct-drive-knuckle (a) + spring-free groove variant (merged from groove-arm-knuckle-3r)
family: redundant 4R with a determined spare (cam-slaved knuckle), direct higher pair
verdict: DEAD at its kill gate: converged best fast near-touch 20.57 on Bench(60,160) (= plain; reach 0.731, follow 1.0, in band 0.863, contact 0) against the gate 15.5, the rod winner's 16.53 and the judge's law-only 14.38. Frozen exact Bench(110,360) 26.21 plain / 27.89 near-touch (rod winner 23.37 / 25.01 same protocol): 2.8 points worse frozen, although simpler (complexity 35.25 vs 46.75). Groove best 95.51. The spec's geometry (arm aimed at J2) is an idle drive: pressure angle 90 deg at the onset.
limiter: Pressure angle: the follower must sit >= 19 mm from u2 with the arm >= 20 deg off the K-J2 line, and the law pushes it out by L_arm x dK; past ~27 mm from u2 the skin is 6-14 mm higher (a flat plate there floats), inside it the plate at link 2's ring level is 18 mm over the skin (8 % in band). So the optimum caps the follower at 31 mm (rho_max): dK 25.9 vs 36 law-only, reach 0.731 vs 0.756. Lug along link 1b (a0 <= 20) collides on 87-138 of 160 poses; stacked over the plate it is 0 % in band. Frozen losses: fold 106 of 360, knee window 7, overhead 8/28.
note: Model docs/concepts/models/rim-lobe-arm-knuckle-3r.py on the winner's module (kit-rule B, phys q2 stop, near-touch, VModel checks, capK 6) with an exact spherical pair: P(t) = R(uK,-dK) p_arm, pitch C(t) = R(u2,-q2) P(t); gates pa <= 45 (relative-velocity form), lobe material toward u2, convex pitch radius >= rr+1, follower >= HUB_R+rr+1 off u2, lap check over every q2 from the fold stop through the law, rho_max (plate size cap). Metal: lug (8 mm strap, skin-fitted, 60-deg ramps), flat 3 mm plate (one level along u2, every lobe/slot sample), O5 x 3 follower; layering 'low' (lug bottom, follower up into the plate layer, plate = lug top + 1.2) or 'high' (spec: lug a layer over the plate); pairs LUG/PLATE/FOLL vs every hub (hub K with its cap), link, knee, pad, E. Search: 1 seed + 44 local + farm LHS 224 (emb, lay, kK, smhi, a1max, bk1, bk2, L_arm, a0, rr) + 2 farm CMA-ES runs on the near-touch gap (657 + 665 evals, x0 = LHS best and the judge's law; free kK, smhi, a1max, bk1, bk2, L_arm, a0, rho_max). Convergence gate (CMA run b): gain over the 2nd half 0.11 score pts, over the last third 0.09, top-5 spread 0.02 - passes; run a converged at 24.94. Red team: drive metal >= 2.05 mm from the skin (lug, ws poses at 75-90 deg elevation), plate 2.6, roller 12; tightest pairs LUG-L2 1.1 mm, LUG-L1b 1.4, LUG-PLATE 1.6, PL-hubK 2.8; roller axis 37 deg off J2's (crowned roller, point contact); force closure not measured (moot). Frozen exact 26.21 / near-touch 27.89 (verify/rim-lobe-arm-knuckle-3r_best_big_frozen.json). Farm cost ~$0.08.

mechanism.notes: roller embodiment: J1, K, J2, J3 O20 MR117-2RS pairs; lug on link 1a with an O2 Ti pin + MR52ZZ roller; 3 mm Ti lobe plate on link 2; K clock spring onto stop A; pin knee (2 sensed iglidur pins); the cam contact counted as a joint (rolling pair). Groove: no spring, a sliding pair instead of the rolling pair.

audit: 2026-10-16 audit: death STANDS. Gate re-run per source: CMA run b best 20.57, gain 0.11 (2nd half) / 0.09 (last third), top-5 spread 0.02 score pts - converged. Best config re-measured locally on Bench(60,160) fast: 20.57 exactly (reach 0.7312, ib14 0.8631, contact 0). Plate-in-band ceiling: counting the plate's 44 samples all in band gives ib14 0.910 -> gap 16.88 at reach 0.731, still above the rod winner (16.53) and the kill gate (15.5). Probe of rho_max at the best config: 24 -> 60.0 (reach 0.45), 27 -> 34.4 (reach 0.61, ib 0.90), 36 -> 118.5, 45 -> 40.2 (reach 0.731, ib 0.79, contact 0.056); plate_cap 6 changes nothing. No modelling bug, convention error or over-strict check found; reach (K travel) and plate height are coupled through the follower radius. Note: the template refutation test (within 10 of the champion 68.93) is met trivially - every round-7 design beats it - and is not the grounds of this death.
